episodes.title: Former Tate Brothers Spokesperson On WHY She Left Andrew Tate & Tristan Tate
episodes.description:
Piers Morgan Uncensored is joined by Mattea Petrescu, the former spokeswoman for Andrew Tate and Tristan Tate, to react to the controversial online stars' recent arrest and why she decided to stop working for them.

Mattea reveals that she decided to step down from her role as their spokesperson and stop publicly supporting the pair in March 2025 because Andrew Tate was becoming more and more 'unhinged' and difficult to counsel.

She also states that although they never displayed any foul behaviour towards her, it was hard to ignore the amount of stories and accusations that have come out about them.
